messages:
parth: Quick question — should audit exports include a compact "actor_hint" field for UI search? e.g., "actor_hint:""Sara B. (sara@redwood.com)" so console can show "Who did it?" quickly without heavy joins.
maureen: I would prefer separate fields: actor_id + actor_display. actor_hint is brittle (localization, name changes). actor_id is the canonical join key.
sara: Compliance asked explicitly for "searchable, human-friendly, and exported" fields. They want something in NDJSON that maps cleanly to SSO display names.
leon: Can we include both? actor_id, actor_display, and an optional actor_email (or hashed email). PII concerns though.
maureen: We need export modes: full (PII), pseudonymized (hashed/email removed), and redacted. API param like `?pii=full|pseudonym|redact` seems straightforward.
parth: Implementation note — adding actor_email to every event increases payload size across the board. Suggest we add a tiny `actor_summary` computed at export-time instead of storing full email in writepath.
sara: Export consumers want to filter locally like `actor:leon` without extra enrichment. If we only compute at export-time, that breaks ad-hoc filtering on stored events in the console. Tradeoff.
ops-bot: Export job 3178 started for tenant:acme-corp by parth
leon: Idea: store an `actor_ref` small index (actor_id) in events and maintain a compact actor cache in the writepath (TTL short). Export pipeline enriches events by joining to the latest cache snapshot; the console can show a best-effort `actor_display` and mark when stale.
maureen: Console UX: show "Who did it" inline in the event list. If enrichment is async, show an explicit "enriched" badge and `loading` state, with a link to trigger a one-off enrich for that tenant when the user requests export.
parth: On the API shape debate: adding `actor_display_name` and `actor_identifier` as optional fields on the change_event resource — is that acceptable? Backwards compatible but will surface in many places.
sara: Also we need to design export quotas — some tenants export TBs. Add per-tenant export quotas, async streaming exports with cursor/resume, and telemetry on export size + rows.
leon: Rollout plan: feature flag backend + 5% canary for hosted tenants; console bits behind a devex feature flag. Dedicated/private customers should be opt-in since they may enforce different PII rules.
maureen: Security: require admin scope for "full" PII exports. Also record the export action as an audit event and attach `export_signature` (signed metadata) to the bundle for downstream verification. Key rotation required.
parth: Example NDJSON line (pseudonymized):
{"ts":"2026-03-19T12:02:00Z","event":"policy.update","actor_id":"u-123","actor_display":"S. Bhatt","actor_email_hash":"sha256:...","change":{...}}
sara: This looks ok. Next steps: write a short RFC covering API shape, export modes, quotas, and rollout. I'll draft the export privacy matrix.
parth: I'll own export enrichment pipeline, actor cache design, and telemetry.
maureen: I'll own API shape + console mapping, plus RBAC checks for PII modes. Draft by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: RFC created -> https://redwood.internal/docs/rfc/actor-export-enrich
